text:
Ana H: Draft for the product launch blog is up — quick review please. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2B3C (copy pasted below). Can we get approvals on the benchmark claim + hero by EOD? Also need demo ops approvals for a live webinar demo. :eyes:

Mike P: Reading now. Quick Q — are the benchmark numbers from internal runs or public comparisons? We should call out methodology.

Sophie L: Legal quick note: avoid 'beats X' or direct comparison to named vendors. Prefer 'X% lower latency vs baseline' and include test details.

Ana H: Good call. Benchmarks are from Redwood Optimize internal runs; I'll add methodology + a link to eval dashboard: https://redwood.ai/evals/2026-clarity

Priya R: Ops: Wed 10am PT works for demo. We'll reserve a dedicated instance. @devops-bot can you spin up a reserved model variant for the live demo (quantized fallback)?

devops-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4567. Demo env reservation: Wed 10am PT. Model variant v1.2-quant will be staged as fallback.

Mike P: Copy suggestion for hero: 'Ship LLM features with predictable performance, cost, and reliability.' Shorter feels stronger.

Ana H: Replaced hero with Mike's version and added a short 'What changed' bullet list highlighting routing, caching, and rollback.

Sophie L: Legal approves with one wording tweak: change 'enterprise-grade' to 'production-ready' in the intro.

Priya R: Ops approves resources + fallback. Add a sentence to the runbook to automatically switch to quantized variant if latency > 300ms.

Ana H: Added canary + auto-fallback note to the post and runbook. Also included a tiny code snippet for the rollout policy:

```
rollout_policy:
  canary: 10%
  fallback_condition:
    - p95_latency > 300ms
    - error_rate > 1%
```

Elena M: Growth sign-off pending final CTAs. Add 'Sign up for demo' CTA wired to HubSpot form ID GH-2026 and I'll approve for publish

Ana H: Final timeline: lock copy by 6pm PT today, schedule publish for tomorrow 9am PT, webinar registration opens now. Thanks everyone! :partyparrot:
